newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel diffs widen slightly in thin action.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel diffs widen slightly in thin action.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged higher Thursday amid stable July heating oil prices and slightly widening differentials in both centers, traders said, with some Gulf action enlivening the sleepy market.

Prompt USG 54-grade jet fuel for delivery over the Colonial Pipeline in early July was sold for 0.40 cent above July NYMEX futures, while offers on prompt 18th cycle material widened a whisker to 0.35 cent over the July print, players said.
"Most of the action is on the early-July stuff," one Gulf trader said, adding sellers seemed to be enjoying the upper hand. "They're waiting for the deals to come to them."
Diffs on NYH 54-grade also advanced marginally in thin trade, to 1.85 cents over the screen, players said.
